transitions.name: Burn
transitions.notes: Warm orange dip. It does not render the Clipchamp fire asset.

transitions.name: Horizontal banding
transitions.notes: Horizontal slice motion. It does not reproduce the retro scanline asset.

transitions.name: Diagonal soft wipe
transitions.notes: Diagonal wipe from the top-left. FFmpeg edges are hard, not feathered.

transitions.name: Blinds
transitions.notes: Horizontal slices approximate the blinds reveal.

transitions.name: Bloom
transitions.notes: Zoom approximation. It does not add the lens flare.

transitions.name: Collage
transitions.notes: Needs a multi-panel motion-graphics asset; no FFmpeg renderer here.

transitions.name: Pixelate
transitions.notes: Native FFmpeg pixelize transition.

transitions.name: Exchange
transitions.notes: Slide approximation. It does not zoom the outgoing frame out.

transitions.name: Page turn
transitions.notes: 3D page fold needs a motion-graphics renderer.

transitions.name: Reveal
transitions.notes: Native reveal. Swap to revealright, revealup, or revealdown in the catalog if needed.

transitions.name: Liquid streaks
transitions.notes: Needs the liquid motion asset; no FFmpeg renderer here.

transitions.name: Liquid drops
transitions.notes: Needs the liquid motion asset; no FFmpeg renderer here.

transitions.name: Fade through black
transitions.notes: Time-preserving dip to black on a master, or a native boundary fade.

transitions.name: Fade through white
transitions.notes: Time-preserving dip to white on a master, or a native boundary fade.

transitions.name: Fire
transitions.notes: Needs a fire motion asset; no FFmpeg renderer here.

transitions.name: Glitch
transitions.notes: RGB shift and noise over the cue. It is not a full glitch asset.

transitions.name: Glitch reveal
transitions.notes: Stronger RGB shift and contrast. It is not a full glitch asset.

transitions.name: Zoom in
transitions.notes: Native FFmpeg zoom-in transition.

transitions.name: Zoom out
transitions.notes: No native xfade zoom-out. Use zoom-in on the outgoing side or a motion-graphics asset.

transitions.name: Spin
transitions.notes: A 180-degree spin needs a motion-graphics renderer.

transitions.name: Heart
transitions.notes: Needs a heart motion asset; no FFmpeg renderer here.

transitions.name: Wipe right
transitions.notes: Native FFmpeg wipe to the right.

transitions.name: Wipe left
transitions.notes: Native FFmpeg wipe to the left.

transitions.name: Cross blur
transitions.notes: Time-preserving blur on a master, or a native boundary blur.

transitions.name: Cross fade
transitions.notes: Native dissolve between two clips.

transitions.name: Push left
transitions.notes: Native push to the left.

transitions.name: Push right
transitions.notes: Native push to the right.

transitions.name: Push up
transitions.notes: Native push upward.

transitions.name: Push down
transitions.notes: Native push downward.
